name: Checkmate
body:
School conjuration (teleportation); Level antipaladin 2, bard 2, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 2, lathspell 2, legendary ninja 2, paladin 2, psychic 3, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self

DESCRIPTION

With a word and a gesture, you gain an advantageous position. The caster immediately teleports up to 25 ft + 5 ft per caster level to an open square. The targeted square must be in a position that is either adjacent to an ally or allows the caster to gain a flanking bonus.
